nations.rp_mod_notes: A nation built on pageantry, supposed honor, and arrogance that has survived through betrayal, cowardice, and subserviance. Though a prideful people, and previously a regional power standing as rival to the old Athabascans, their constant weakness and cowardice in the face of action or consequence led to a degradation of their reputation and influence until their vassalization under the Conclave. Freed once more among the collapse, it is unknown if they will regain their prominence with such a history, especially as their former allies either despise them or no longer exist.

nations.rp_mod_notes: A deeply isolationist culture of humanoid dragon folk, The Draconic Empire holds a deep contempt for all except the Aubivante of Forevante. Their lands upon the holy super volcano they reside have been trespassed over tenfold, their religion has been forcefully annihilated by Usonian war and missionaries, and their attempts at revenge against those foreigners who have wronged them are quickly dashed. They consider themselves a cursed people at this point, all starting with the ancient immortal cursed twins and their bargain.

Ruled by one of two branch families of the Nei Lu called the Nei Lu Hūn, Xi Nei Lu is a daughter state to Jinying in all aspects. Protected and supported, they provide resources and loyal administration of far away territories on behalf of the main Nei Lu dynasty.

Xi nei lu is the elder sister, and being situated among the western mountain range, they provide the majority of Jinying's stone and metallurgical needs. Their architecture often is built or carved out of the mountains themselves, their cities being the former sides or outcroppings of the mountain they reside upon.

nations.rp_mod_notes: Heiwa Kokka was a nation founded around mutual benefit, community, and peaceful coexistence. Early Hitsujinamekuji society began to develop in the oceans reefs and tide pools, with groups coming together for strength in numbers and aid. Soon, they came to find that the more of them there were, the easier it was to survive against predators of any type. Eventually, the first tribes were formed surrounding large bands who simply foraged along the coasts and within the forests. They began to combine bands more and more, as getting along was relatively easy with all having similar wishes in survival and life, eventually leading to the entire species within the area coming together in one large tribe. They became a roving horde that would, even in their sheer size, be gentle and caring for their surroundings. They began to experiment with arts of many kinds early on as they had no desire for violence, focusing more on the enjoyment of life and its possibilities.

Eye of Nanu choice was +2 prowess, +2 cunning. Gains +2 to all rolls for the rest of his life.

The Promised Sage:

Your character reduces the DC of all attribute and military strength training mech-rps by 5, doubled for training mech-rps done for other characters; additionally, the limit on how many attribute training mech-rps may be done per session is instead limited to the type instead of the mech-rp itself (i.e, you could train three different attributes during a session). Gaining one elderly start time for both every beast they defeat in a duel, and also every attribute they train (to a max of +2 gained each session between the two). Each time this character trains a specific attribute five times (whether on themselves or others), that attribute cap increases for them, to a maximum of +10. Additionally, once every five sessions this character may choose to duel an Epic mythical figure, stealing a portion of their unique strength, and adding it to this title (a maximum of five unique effects may be stored this way).

Lastly, the first time this character dies, or whenever the owner decides, this character may mysteriously cease to exist, returning whenever their owner decides at half their age and with a new random artifact (which may not be within the next 10 sessions).

Star Touched Form:
Upon her flesh, glistens patterns of ‘stars’, more accurately are diamonds, even when she doesn’t utilise any magick. When she utilises her power, more ‘stars’ grow upon her body and begin to light up with starlight, a physical indicator of both the mana she is pulling into herself and the scale of power she possesses.

Boon Effect:
Can utilise nation magic/spell specific modifiers (such as Apprentices, Magical etc.) for character spells.

Minor Pact with Vandros:
**[While both of you live, you both gain slightly increased chances of success on all attempts to increase levels of relations with AI]** https://discord.com/channels/1188889187018088488/1336064472082812961/1336065424391147552

Black Rose Barrier:
Any dispel that targets this character's upkept spells must target this spell first, or suffer -8 on the contested magic check.
 When this spell is dispelled, the hostile caster suffers either -3 rolling karma, -2 health states, or a random tier 3 negative title; determined by caster.  
All duel rolls (where they are the defender) made against this character suffer a -4 penalty.  

Pact: gain 1 permanent character mana production for as long as this pact exists**

races.name: Prunambulat
races.description: Prunambulats are humanoid creatures. The primary features distinguishing them from humans are their black horns on the head and their black-colored eyeballs. In a few specimens, a reptile-like tail has been observed, but this appears to be an exception, and these individuals usually cannot fully control it, often leading to trouble. Another characteristic is scattered patches of scales on their skin. Even though this seems to be purely aesthetic use among the Prunambulats, this mixture of strange characteristics makes it difficult to determine the origin of this race. Among Prunambulats, black horns are often compared to determine who is stronger or more experienced to solve the problem. Biologically, the horns collect the sun's heat during the day and release it during the cold nights to warm the body. In contrast, the black eyeballs have no particular social value, but they help them to see better during the day by absorbing excess sunlight.

races.name: Skoroi
races.description: Large humanoid moths with beige, peach, white and muddy colourations of various parts, black eyes, mandibles, antennae, wings, claws, an additional abdomen, fluffy collars and chitin covering their bodies, a more rubbery one on their face. They usually have hair and retain it for the entirety for their lives. They are naturally inclined to seek out shiny and bright light-producing objects. They require a rather large amount of food due to their restrictive diet, a big part of which are naturally occurring fibres like fur. In the time of myth and legend, the Southern Skóroi on the island encountered odd flowers and gained a blue colouration in parts of fur and hair, where it had been popular to weave the flowers.

races.name: Goblin
races.description: A normally small, green, race of people; standing at around four  feet (4’) tall, to at most around six feet (6’) in height, and ranging from hues of green that spanned from the darkest Olive green, to a vibrant Forest green. Most goblins tend to naturally hunch a fair amount, taking away some height from their already short stature, though also making them appear a slight bit bulkier, despite their inherently lithe physique. All goblins tend to have long, distorted, and leering features; wide smiles, frowns, and long noses are notable facial features.

races.name: Vampiric Eidola
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Mycelis
races.description: A menacing fungal hive mind that flourishes in scorching landscapes. This parasitic entity prefers to take root in the searing heat of geothermally active regions and volcanic expanses. The Mycelis manifests as pulsating, orangish fungi, releasing spores to infiltrate and control host individuals. Once infected, these hosts lose their autonomy, becoming drones manipulated by the collective will of the Mycelis. While not particularly intelligent on its own, by assimilating others races it eventually absorbs their knowledge, which is added to the collective. Mycelis that are removed from the conglomerate can act with some level of independence.

races.name: Lanzeshawks
races.description:
The Lanzeshawks is an off-shoot branch of the Zrietas species with their creation being attributed to the necessary of war and conflict in the very early history of Firenzia. Under the guidance of Lunari - the Goddess of the Moon, Ida the Magical (or the Mad depends on who you ask) uses her magiccal talents and knowledge of mutagenic plants to create an army of supersoldiers from the ordinary Zrietas. Little does she know, that her creation would have a profound impact on Firenzia, and the entirety of the Sentinel's Watch region itself.

The Lanzeshawks are taller and quite bulkier than the Zrietas ( with 7.5 ft - 8.5 ft in height). They have a humanoid body shape with thicker bones, bulkier and more flexible muscles, dexterous hand-talons with opposable thumbs, their eyes are better and much more suited for night activities, characterized by their red-orange glow in the dark. Furthermore, they also have a very keen sense of smell, being able to track down preys miles away based on just their scent alone. However, for all these talents, comes a huge trade-off: the characteristic colorful feathers and coats of the Zrietas are no more, in its place are simple black-brown-white pattern feathers. Their vocal cords can no longer produce the beautiful sounds made back in their original form, and their manners have been devolved into a bit more primal state compared to their sophisticated Zreitas brothers. Their muscles and genes itself are imbued with magic and mutagens, however, they're also quite helpless in controlling and casting magic, as well as being incapable of long-distance flight: A characteristic trait of the Giornian Mountain Birds.

races.name: Fluttergeist
races.description:
Strange wispy people, able to fly and even briefly see into the future at times. While this ability is rather strong, it is limited to random, subconscious moments that are used to prevent harm befalling the Fluttergiest. In this way, they are able to avoid danger, but cannot use it to do much of anything else. One quirk of this ability is that it seems completely unable to show them when they might die; thus they are starkly terrified of interacting with things that could lead to their deaths.

They are relatively small, and usually prefer living in the treetops away from dangerous ground predators.

races.name: Ryongsa
races.description:
The Ryŏngsa is an isolationist race.
They are proficient with magic, yet are arrogant towards other races.
The Ryŏngsa skin resembles the scales of a dragon, with a pale texture, ‘golden’ horns, sharp teeth, and eyes that gleam with ‘gold’.
According to folklore, they were believed to be the offspring of the ‘Nine Jiaolong’ who descended from the heavenly court.

races.name: Vampiric Carcuka
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Valzeen Moss
races.description: Description: The Valzeen Moss is a purplish-red moss that is capable of handling harsh environmental conditions. It grows at a steady rate from a strange hole in the ground, and seems to have a level of sentience that would deem it intelligent life. It appears to be a single lifeform that has gradually taken root over many miles of land, and can integrate other living species into its unified hivemind-like intelligence. This typically takes the form of “lower” species such as insects and birds, but it is certainly not limited to such. In fact, very recently, it appears to have gained control of a goblin, and has acquired a new level of sapience…

races.name: Lilado
races.description:
The Lilado are small flower sprites from the “Mother Tree,” made of petals and magic. They sprung forth all at once from plants that suddenly withered. Standing only a foot tall on average, they struggle to gather resources much larger than themselves. Magic, however, comes to them as naturally as breathing - and, in fact, eating. Lilado feed psychically on the emotions of living creatures. This can make it hard to find enough food to sustain them in large numbers (there are only so many creatures in the woods capable of complex emotion, after all) but luckily some emotions can be… induced artificially, in almost any animal. 

Lilado are only female, and reproduce clonally by creating a seed from themselves and nurturing it. They call each other “sister,” and instinctively know one another’s names upon meeting. They say they are connected by the “Mother Tree” - upon birth they know only that they came from her and that they miss her. They can’t remember where she is, only that “she’s somewhere cold.”

Be wary of their cute appearance and kind demeanor - a biting chill follows their touch, and they are able to twist it to deadly ends if provoked to violence.

races.name: Hitsujina
races.description: The Hitsujinamekuji were born from the sheep slug of the planet's reefs and rivers, evolving towards becoming a hybrid of fauna and flora through the consumption of algae. When they evolved to travel across land, they soon began to eat the plants upon it and take their chloroplasts over the algae’s. Due to this, they gained the ability to grow larger and create new imitation leaves to aid them in photosynthesis. Now, they are a vibrant species of many different colors and shapes thanks to their diverse herbivore diet and many photosynthesizing limbs.

races.name: Inspira
races.description:
The Inspira (Homo-Inspiratus or The Inspired Man) are a Variant Race of Humanity. They are well known for their advanced cognitive abilities and a deep seated drive for exploration and knowledge. While they look Very much like their Human Kin there are some subtle differences that give them away. Where humans typically are born with Brown eyes the Inspira on the other hand are typically born with Blue eyes.  Additionally the Inspira are being with an Extra rib allowing for a greater intake of air, this adds to their greatest difference, their overall height, at an average of 6 ft.

Due to their near indistinguishability from Their Human Kin the Inspirans and have long had a habit of absorbing one another peoples in different parts of the world. It is speculated that this is the reason why some humans are born with Blue eyes and some Inspirans are born with Brown eyes, with Green coming in as a natural mutation from the Mixing of these two human Species (The Consider themselves to be Humans)

races.name: Kromaylin
races.description: Shimmering beings composed of living prisms, refracting light in mesmerizing patterns. Kromaylin typically fair best in the desert, where the unfettered light of the sun blinds those that may wish them harm. Due to their simplistic biology, they may live quite a long time; that is, of course, if they are not shattered in the process. This same simple biology that allows them to live for so long, also makes them rather fragile. This is why Kromaylin are naturally conflict-averse and will try to stay out of harms way if possible.

races.name: Ignikin
races.description: People with a fiery essence that covers a majority of their bodies. While the essence itself is not actually fire, it does let off a significant amount of heat, and light. They tend to live in colder environments, as not to easily overheat. They may burn brightly, but they also burn quickly.

races.name: Puqua
races.description: Brought to sapience by a wandering sage, these porcupine folk are adapted to the cold and frigid environments more then what would be expected for a race such as them. Maybe the secrets in the quills . . .

races.name: Rock
races.description: They are rocks... and they're not happy about being up...

races.name: Marathon
races.description: he runners culture obsess over the start and the ways the planets travels. Encouraging the people to travel and trade learning about the stars and their patterns through trade and communication. they usually stay within red and brown with some black feathers

races.name: Mole
races.description: Mole

races.name: Uhra
races.description:
Description: A race that come from the mountains through a process that only occur though the most miraculous alignment of natural instances. They are a rare people to come across, mostly due to their low numbers. Thus, there has never been enough to progress into a civilisation unlike the races around them. However, through the passage of time and watching those around them, these sturdy people are just as capable and intuitive as those that surround them.

Roaming around the world, these people craft their own weapons in order to survive unforgiving place they find themselves in. These constant hurdles have made them adept in fighting. Soon becoming their specialty.

races.name: Fleshbound
races.description: The remnants of an ancient experiment, which resulted in constructs gaining sentience. Most were enslaved in permanent servitude to the ancient Dravapuran Empire before its collapse. The Fleshbound vary wildly in design, purpose, method of reproduction, height, weight, limbs, intellect, and almost everything else. Many are simply bound by their purpose: to survive in a world which so recently despised them.

races.name: Salt Troll
races.description: This race draws its origins to the Dravapura Empire, where they, despite being members of their species, enslaved and bred to serve as physical labour and Slave Soldiers. Upon the dissapearance of the Dravapura Empire, it appeared that the Salt Trolls were left behind to forge their own destiny... However chaotic that may be

races.name: Vampiric Borgolow
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Teddy Bears
races.description:
The staple children's toys that have come to life. These teddy bears are made of Mohair fur and filled with Kapok fibre. All of them are varied in looks as their creator used a variety of dyes with his creations. Though, within all of them, lies their stuffed red heart; the source of their being. They are not charismatic in the way that they are smooth with their words, they cannot even speak (yet) even if they wanted to. Instead, they radiate the feeling of love and care through their being and actions. They will do almost anything to help another race out just as if they were to help themselves. For what powers these small creatures is love, the love of progress, the love of friendship and the love of doing. Then again, these are just teddy bears so they aren't exactly made for fighting.

Care bear

races.name: Vampiric Inspira
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Maiken
races.description: An adult Maiken is near indistinguishable from a human. However, when you get closer you may notice a few differences. Their eyes often have strange patterns in them. Very similar to those of a frog's eye. They have elongated tongues that they can use as a defensive mechanism. Larger muscles in their legs. In fact one of their ancestors seems to have been a frog. It is quite the mystery how they developed into their current state.

races.name: Orchal
races.description:
From forsaken lands north of north, the Orchal came.

Towering humanoids whose males reach well over seven and a half feet tall, the sturdy Orchal are a sight to behold. 

They are broad, dark of hair with eerily piercing blue eyes. Originating from the harshest of environments, the large humanoids are able to continue to do strenuous activity for days before finally collapsing. Their skin is rough, but surprisingly quiet warm to the touch.

In spite of their large size, or perhaps because of it, Orchals aren't naturally aggressive and tend to be slow to anger.

The Orchal didn't view their strange power as supernatural in origin until they began interacting with other races. Their magic is internal in nature, a natural mastery of their will fortifying their flesh, minds, and burning souls to accomplish herculean feats otherwise impossible.

races.name: Makyrissan
races.description:
In truth the race known as the Mákyrissan is a tale of two peoples. Firstly, all appear in truth to appear human. It is safer to believe this ‘race’ to be more a subsection of humanity than anything else, though such a thought cannot be confirmed. For the men, that is obvious in all matters, mundane in magic but trying as hard as any ‘human’ could be. The Mákyrissan in truth refers to the females of the ‘species’. All women bear the inherent magical gifts that the Roses, capable with training to craft spells and raise the dead, such is the main prowess of the Coven. All, when their gifts materialize, hold a twinkle of vermillion in their irises along with their natural colour. As well, some are born with startling silver hair, though that is a rarity even for their number. And whilst most don’t travel beyond their home, it is said they have the ability to sustain warmth in cold climates, or retain a cool form in hotter climates. Suggesting an inherent gift to control their own body temperatures.

In truth the most notable aspect of the Mákyrissan women that one can see, is something that can only be seen with time - they do not age, physically anyway. Once a lady of the Coven has reached their early to mid forties, physically they stop the aging process. They are not immortal, however, but the magical properties of their blood that separates them from their male counterparts means that even on their deathbed, they appear young.

As a result, bar the lack of physical aging, the alleged body temperature control and subtle eye and hair colours, what makes the women different is their blood as of present day. It is their bloodlines and gifts that truly make them Mákyrissan.

races.name: Vampriric Qraws
races.description:
Read Main Page

They Like Blood

races.name: Transhuman
races.description: The men of the Transhuman race are manufactured rather than born leading to almost superhuman abilities most of which lost to time and extreme struggle undertaken by former holders. All Transhumans are created from exceptional individuals, each harboring some trace of magical abilities and a steel only held by those who could be considered demigods. No man born into Transhumanism could ever fall to the corruptions of darker planes.

races.name: Afaka
races.description:
From the sea came the Afaka - faceless forms made of water bearing the shape of man. From the sea fled the Afaka. They will not go back. Even if it kills them. 

The only memory they have is desire. The desire to break free from the swirling eternity of their mother and be free, to be different, to have a face and an identity apart from the whole. This desire is what burns at the core of every Afaka. On the other side of their desire is fear - what if they are forced back? What if they meld again? This fear drives Afaka away from bodies of water. Maybe everything will be okay, but not a single one is willing to risk it. This puts them in a precarious position - in their search to avoid the call of water, they often put themselves into environments hostile to their own existence. 

Almost as a curse to their want for identity, all Afaka look the same. Their bodies are all smooth and blank, resembling human kind but devoid of a face beyond their mouth. Despite being comprised of water, they are only slightly translucent (appearing a cloudy blue) and need to eat to maintain energy and hold themselves together. They are a young race, and so far have produced few offspring. While they can’t reproduce by conventional means, those brave enough to collect a bucket of water have been able to create a smaller one of their kind through concentration and care. 

Though counter-intuitive, their fear lends them great courage. Anything can be conquered in the face of the eternal rage of the sea. Anything that threatens their newfound independence should prepare to fight tooth and nail, down to the last Afaka, because they aren’t going back.

races.name: Rye
races.description:
Spirits highly attuned to their secluded section of the forest. They can freely float but they tend not to go above tree level. Their inherent form is wispy-like with a simple face to show expression. However to outsiders, this is a form they show to those they deemed highly trustworthy. Instead, a few select Rye maintain  barrier of fog to hide with the intention for outsiders to be redirected outside the forest.

Their objective is one simple in nature, protecting their home by any means possible. As the forest caretakers, most members of the race devote themselves maintaining the ground, slowly pruning (however rarely) aged trees and planting new life in their area. For a select few, some may journey outside the forest and observe outside events that may affect their home, form the protective spell which shadows the true intention of their forest or guard the secret which they believe would bring ruin to the world if ever exposed.

Their race can be linked to the distant past with memories lingering to the simultaneous fall to a vast amount of civilisations. With their millennia's worth of knowledge, they could make a great partner for understanding concepts waiting to be rediscovered. However, making an enemy of them and any chances of that will be lost forever.

races.name: Borgolow
races.description: Very burly people. Known for survivability in harsh conditions. Borgolows are innately resilient and trusting. Because of this they overlook the samaller, but important, things causing their unluckiness. This could be thoughts such as saying, “eh ill live” to a dangerous situation that make their luck abysmal

races.name: Lusari
races.description:
Human on the surface, the Lusari (people of the light, the enlightened, those who illuminate) are an unusually diverse population in both cultures and features for their relatively scant population. Despite their small numbers, they have proven capable of works that seemingly defies their meager manpower. They have used this industrious spirit to carve themselves a home in the frozen wastes.

There's little to distinguish them, however, from other Human races, sans two notable differences. A small portion of their population is capable of a unique form of magic; Drafting, or the ability to convert light into physical substance. For the non magical majority, however, a keen eye can still tell them apart from general humanity. Outsiders have documented a slight haze around Lusari individuals, observable only from the corner of one's vision, as if the very light bends around them.

races.name: Lumirans
races.description:
The Lumirans are a race of energy beings, their forms once radiant with vibrant, pulsating light that could illuminate entire realms. Now, however, they have faded to a dull glow, their brilliance having greatly dimmed over time. These ethereal beings, composed of pure energy, are believed to have been created by an ancient, long-forgotten civilization, rather than being born of natural causes. The veracity of this belief has yet to be confirmed.

The Lumirans carry an air of melancholy, their movements slow and subdued as they drift through the world. They often sulk in the shadows, their once-glorious radiance reduced to a faint shimmer, if that. It is said that deep within, the Lumirans long for the golden age when their light was unrestrained, and they were revered as their creators' most magnificent work. This yearning for a lost time of splendor and purpose has left them in a state of perpetual sorrow, their energy flickering with the remnants of a past that feels ever out of reach.

races.name: Folks of Flaerk
races.description: Along the [] river lies the vast wetland created by the system of reservoirs that the industrious beavers of Flaerk constructed for potentially thousands of years, this ecosystem of abundant resources attracted other wildlife and animal folks. Later, around 300 years ago otter began to migrate into the nearby water down the river delta, due to the abundant amount of sea urchins in the region, providing food for the otter, permanent settlements along the shores were built, fostering trade between the beavers and animals upstream with the otter near the coast. its for the cooperative nature that these various creatures created that the people outside of the region start grouping them together to what is now known as the Flaerk Fur Folks

races.name: Sithid
races.description: The Sithids are hulking, uneven monstrosities of rock and crystal, their forms a fractured mockery of the harmony they once embodied. Towering and jagged, they shimmer faintly with an inner luminescence, as veins of glowing minerals pulse beneath their cracked exteriors. Their movements are slow and deliberate, each step resonating with the weight of ancient sorrow; they almost seem in a state of constant dull pain. Once a proud and unified species, their current state reflects the toll of eons of travel, their bodies held together by forces barely understood. Deep-set, glowing-blue eyes burn with a mix of grief and determination, revealing a relentless drive to endure despite their shattered existence.

races.name: Undead Shardling
races.description: Brains!!!

races.name: Minotaur
races.description: Tall muscled creatures with an aggressive culture, noted by the horned head and other cow esque features.

races.name: Laoshu Ren
races.description:
Evolving in the far eastern stretches past the arid mountains, the Lǎoshǔ rén or Mice Folk evolved within the Forests, rivers, and marshes of the coast. 

They stand at an average of 3-4 feet, standing on two legs but often travelling on four. They resemble their smaller brethren, but have 5 fingered appendages and less fur.

Despite their relatively small stature, they are brave and tenacious often having taken down much larger foes through sheer will and numbers. However, thanks to their smaller stature and often moving around quite a bit, they must eat multiple meals a day to keep up their energy and live lesser lives then many other races around the world. 

They are not as in tune with magic as some other folk, but do have shaman/wizard bloodlines that carry the ability to manipulate the weave. They, however, prefer to rely on their own ingenuity and ability.

races.name: Bugaboo
races.description:
A strange race of short gnomish forest dwellers, the bugaboo have a natural gift for illusions, subterfuge, and the secret paths of the world. They often appear where others least expect them, and are known to surprise, surround, and swarm their foes before slipping away.

No bugaboo has ever died of old age. Unfortunately this is due to the growing madness that addles them and worsens over time. This madness drives them to take increasingly dangerous actions until they reach an untimely end. It is not uncommon to see an elder bugaboo attempting to wrestle with a large predator, climb atop a tall tree before attempting to fly, or other dangerous activities

races.name: Frostling
races.description: Short humanoid ice like creatures, found as servants of Arkrax they are now free.

races.name: Al'Trox
races.description: He a big ol rock

races.name: Vampiric Mycelis
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Hwaitees
races.description: The Hwaitees are a race which has evolved to adapt to their surroundings by constantly shedding their flesh and skin, from prey to predators they have acquired an evolutionary trait that makes them quite unique. The ability to metamorphose to any kind of species they have devoured. A simple pound of meat, some bones or the blood of their victims is all it takes for them to acquire the ability. The transformation is neither fast nor easy. It takes time and a lot of energy, the time and energy heavily depends on the appearance they must adopt and once taken they do not take upon their skills (Strength, magic, etc), much akin to a costume made of flesh and bone. Their ability to change appearance is a closely kept secret as its their main tool of infiltration into foreign societies, as such Hwaitees take the form of sirens, ancient natives of the island they now inhabit and which have been transformed into mindless livestock after generations of being devoured to their children so they could take up their shapes.

races.name: Stone Seraph
races.description: A lifeless stone creature with an angelic form. Seemingly unable to move while witnessed.

races.name: Solnar
races.description: Magical beings who emit a bright glow from their body and their heads being a ball of fire like the sun that emits a blinding glow. The solnar dwell in the desert of the south, they natural traders and explorers, as they are natural lights and have a natural connection with the stars. But in order to be near other beings they need to wear a helmet to not blind other creatures.

races.name: A-113C Droid
races.description: An ancient custodian droid created by a civilization so old, it likely predates life on this planet.

races.name: Ekkros
races.description:
The Ekkros are a race of agile, feline humanoids resembling lynxes, known for their swift reflexes, powerful legs, and sharp senses. They have tawny fur with distinctive black markings and tufted ears, giving them a wild, predatory appearance. These people are exceptionally fast, able to traverse rugged terrain with incredible speed, making them formidable hunters and scouts.

Their fear of water stems from an ancient legend passed down through generations: the Ekkros believe that a great flood once nearly wiped out their ancestors, who could not swim well due to their dense fur, which became waterlogged. This event has ingrained a deep-seated fear of large bodies of water in their children, leading them to avoid rivers, lakes, and seas whenever possible. As a result, they have developed their land-based agility to perfection, relying on their speed and stealth to survive. Honestly, it is unknown if they would actually do poorly in water, but they are certainly too afraid to check.

races.name: Ludus
races.description: Bold and hardy, the Ludus are known as courageous warriors, farmers, and workers of the land. Their bodies are covered in a shell which is rigid but supple as the situation demands in jointed parts of the body such as the fist. They are not, however, strictly invertebrate, having an internal skeleton broadly resembling that of a human. Outwardly, Ludus vary widely, most obviously in that a caste of Ludus from the Frigid Caps and surrounding tundras have stark white shells- the Niveus- while those from the Verdant Plains and beyond are pitch black- the Furvus. Beyond coloration, however, it does not seem that the two castes are at all biologically different.

races.name: Zrietas
races.description:
The Zrietas is a race of bird-people who were (mysteriously) and magically evolved from a species of (eagle-like) raptor which predominantly lives around the mountainous peaks of Mount Jornia. They have retained much of their avian characteristics such as their beaks, raptor eyes, feathers (full body), wings, talons and a feathered tail after their sudden evolution. However, that’s where the similarities end with their feral counterparts. 

The uplifted Zrietans are bigger (6 ft avg. - 7'5 ft for biggest specimen), have more of a humanoid body shape with a different digestive system, thicker bones, special vocal cord, dexterous hand-talons with opposable thumbs and most important of all - a much more developed brain capable of complex decision making, problem solving and advanced cooperation with others of the same species. They are now partially-omnivorous (they could consume both meat and plant matters, but meat is still easier for them to digest), their thicker bones means they are now more durable, their hand-talons are capable of manipulating different objects in the surrounding environment and their brain allow them to band together, to strategize, and to be more than just savage beasts. It is their vocal cord that sets the Zrietas apart from the other races though - as the sound they make is not simply the screeching of a bird. It now follows a certain melody, is clearer and easier to comprehend - and as other races describe it - sounds like a beautiful song that no one would get tired of hearing. 

This evolution also comes with a cost too - their wings can no longer generate enough lift to bring them to the sky, as they only now use it as a glider when they want to get down to less elevated terrain (like a flying squirrel). Furthermore, this magical evolution has severely hindered their ability to cast and learn spells.

races.name: Vampiric Stouten
races.description:
See Main Page

They Like Blood

races.name: Shardlings
races.description: It is said that the Shardlings were once a piece of a greater magical artifact, something that once broke, shattered into a million pieces. These pieces, used to being together for so long, quickly united together once more; this time, in the form of civilizations. Often clinging to high cliffs and mountain edges, Shardlings are blessed with an innate ability to hover wherever they please. A token of their unnatural form. This token comes with two-sides however, and the downside of their form makes it nearly impossible to work with their hands. Lacking opposable thumbs, or any real defined way to finely manipulate, they often struggle to do work on their own. This has led to the semi-common occurrence of Shardlings seeking out assistance, in many forms, from other creatures. Many feel a longing for a time they do not understand, a time where they held a greater purpose.

races.name: Lachiwa
races.description:
The Lachiwa are a race of bipedal reptilian pollinators originating from the dense jungle islands of the southern channel. A sudden, unexplained explosion in the growth of the island’s mega flora over the past hundred years has allowed them to slowly grow more plentiful and gain stability previously unheard of. They exhibit extreme sexual dimorphism - so much so that someone unfamiliar with them might think they were different species entirely. Males are suited to collecting nectar from the jungle’s massive flowers. They have a long proboscis (secondary to their tongue) that they can use to collect nectar, storing it in cheek pouches to later deposit in the hive and turn into honey. Their bodies are small, but their wings are large and dexterous, and are able to carry them long distances through the jungle’s dense canopy in search of new flowers. 

Females are much larger than males, and are suited to create massive caverns underground where honey can be stored and the tribe can over-winter. They’re very light sensitive, and their hands are large and spade-shaped, used in tandem with scooped tusks to assist them in digging. Despite their large shape, they have fine-tuned control over their fingers and have begun to craft with them. Their wings are small, almost vestigial, and can’t be used for much more than slowing a fall. Now that their search for nectar isn’t quite so desperate, they’ve found the time to draw weird shapes on the walls, give each other shiny rocks, and think about what could make their honey taste better.

races.name: Kewala
races.description: The Kewala are a tall, lizard-like people from a variety of different types of lizards coming from a land far away having a history of conflict during their migrations overcoming it with raw strength rather then magic of other races. While their not diet is not completely carnivorous they do have a preference for meat compared to the other edible foods scavenged around.

races.name: Kamuy
races.description:
n short Kamuy are nature’s spirits with overbloated ego.

Each individual Kamuy is a amalgamation of many little spirits - of water, clouds, wind, stone etc, that fused together to survive and preserve their ego, their self consciousness. They appear in many shapes and forms, depending on what spirits they have managed to absorb so far. The strongest are even able to absorb the souls of the living beings, and as such manifest as various animals and plants. The will that drives the individual Kamuy belongs to the strongest of the parts, but that doesn’t mean the others remain stationary. To see Kamuy before you is to watch an ever shifting, half gaseous form, in the depths of which the eyes of the spirits and other shapes manifest for a brink of a second, only to change the next. 

Remaining in a fully material form requires an intense concentration, when they loose it or are damaged, the Kamuy dissipates back to a mist form.

The reason they’re intensely hydrophobic comes from a very important difference in the psychology - the Kamuy are a fusion of many, the will of one. The big bodies of water naturally fuse the many, many identical spirits of the water, without giving them sentience - “the voice of many, the will of none one”. The sheer unifying spiritual pressure of a lake, river, or sea that is extended to the spirits of water within each Kamuy, is an immense threat of either being ripped apart or even worse - being drawn in whole, subjugated and integrated forever inside the sleeping giant.

races.name: Leonine
races.description: Aggressive humanoids with lion features, known for their love of battle and flesh.

races.name: Kotsáni
races.description:
Cousins of the nearly-extinct Emporos, with legs of either a goat or other bovidae species, the Kotsáni have their major divergence in the area that connects their halves, instead of a twinkling night sky, Vines, Ivy and Moss have grown over. Also Unlike their adventurous cousins, the Kotsáni chose to become the grovekeepers of the northern forests, following more strict migration patterns and aiming to check up on each part of the forest.

They also have a strong disdain for large open bodies of water, and rather go by the forest than by the sea.

races.name: Lionhearts
races.description:
From initial inspection, one might just assume that the people of this race are ... literally humans, they look like humans, talk, eat and drink like humans do. There is not notable features on their appearance to discern otherwise. However, just as an onion has layers, these people their major aspect hidden from the eyes of others. 

The first major difference from humanity one might notice is that they are not a mundane race at all, once they might see these people having to use instruments and scrolls to cast their spells, yet now they are all capable of doing it outright without any support.

And secondly, they have a beastly secret kept well hidden by all members of their race, revealed only to their most trusted allies, or their most terrible rivals: They possess the power to turn into a hulking Lion-human Hybrid at will (or Werelions for short). While being in this form, their body swell to three times their normal size; they grow razor sharp fangs, mane, tail and fur, their face morphed into the shape like that of a lion. Their muscle grows and their bone structure changes, giving them supernatural sense, strength and especially their signature lightning fast speed of an apex predator. Even in the Lionheart's human forms, if one spend enough time around them, he would notice that they have much better reaction time, speed, vision, sense of smell and hearing than the average human. Their eyes would sometimes even glow in the dark, yet more often than not they try to cover it to avoid detection, or misunderstanding to other races.

Yet this comes with a huge cost. Their fearsome appearance and manner in such a terrible form more often than not are mistaken for another Wild Werebeast - thus earning them a bad reputation, as others try to stay away to avoid catching their "curse", or just too intimidated to even talk to them.
They were once known as the humans of the Anglish Isle, same as any other humans, from any other places around the Shatteredlands, yet - George B. Bush, one of their greatest leaders have made a deal with Heaven to acquire the power of nature in order to fulfill its will upon the mortal realm. Thus, the "Lionhearts Gift" was bestowed upon them, allowing them to do magic at will and have the strength to do their duty on this world.

races.name: Chitran
races.description:
The Chitran are a race of spider-like humanoids, with ten limbs—four arms and six legs—each ending in dexterous, claw-tipped fingers. Their exoskeletal bodies are covered in a fine, chitinous armor, and their eyes, set in clusters, give them an eerie, otherworldly appearance. The Chitran are exceptional crafters and builders, using their multiple arms to weave intricate webs, forge delicate tools, and construct complex structures with precision and speed. Their natural ability to produce silk makes them unrivaled in textile creation and architectural design, often resulting in cities suspended in vast webs.

However, the Chitran struggle with communication with other races due to their peculiar spider-like mouths, which are better suited for producing clicking and hissing sounds rather than articulate speech. This makes it difficult for them to learn and speak other languages fluently, often leading to misunderstandings and social isolation. Despite their impressive intelligence and creativity, their unsettling appearance and alien way of speaking often cause other races to view them with suspicion or fear. How unfortunate that Arachnophobia seems to be a universal fear.

races.name: Glüsken
races.description: Gelatinous creatures with adaptable forms, resembling animated, translucent ooze. The color of this ooze is associated directly with their age, with the darker colors being older. Glüsken prefer colder climates, as their hardened ooze allows them to move more easily. Despite this, their strange biology allows them to move freely through the water. They reproduce in a way strange to most other creatures, not quite asexually, nor sexually. Two adult Glüsken fuse together, staying that way for months, sometimes years, before they split apart. Once this happens, they do not return to their previous forms, but rather split into tens of newer, younger Glüsken. In this way, parenthood does not exist, as death is required to bring forth new life. They are odd creatures, sadly plagued by unrelenting fate. With no real explanation, Glüsken seem to suffer worse fates than any other race.

races.name: Thumpkins
races.description: The Thumpkins are a unique species of sentient Jackalope creatures, well-versed in their mystical forms of magic. Their Rhythm Magic is held sacred within their burrows, and they perform ritualistic dances to honor their god, Rhythmos. A Thumpkin's antlers, far from being merely decorative, serve as magical musical instruments. Each antler produces a distinctive sound when struck or touched, and enhances their connection to rhythm magic. The Thumpkins communicate using the sounds from their antlers and foot thumps, creating a cooperative and goal-oriented community. They are pacifists by nature, preferring to learn new melodies and rhythms from different cultures instead of engaging in conflict

races.name: Undead Whisperfolk
races.description: Brains!!!

races.name: Mutatum
races.description:
The Mutatum are goliaths - they resemble humans closely, but are much larger and have a clay-like texture to their skin. Their greatest strength is their ability to adapt their traits to the temperature of their environment, growing in strength with the heat and in wit with the cold. They are at their peak in the temperature they were born into, and excel much less in the opposite. 

Though they eat, drink, are born and die like any other living thing, Mutatum have a strange “created” quality to them that sometimes calls their origin into question. Sometimes. If it’s cold and anyone has the time to think hard about something like that. 

Mutatum can be found in pockets across the world, with traditions that vary greatly (just as they do) by their environment.

races.name: Maskay
races.description:
The Maskays are a race of gangly, mostly light-skinned humanoids, long-limbed and hunched over. Very little of their actual skin is visible, as they are covered in mud, sticks and leaves and all wear a mask made out of bark over their faces. Many speculate that their near-constant hunger and unnatural thinness are two facets of the same coin with Maskays being simply naturally “high maintenance”.

While the youngest or most magically dull members of the species might have inert masks, a common magical rite of passage across Maskay cultures is awakening the mask so it starts following your own face’s movement, with the complexities in its mimicry of organic movement and of its design and ornaments being a signifier of both magical aptitude and status amongst the Maskays.

Maskays keep silent unless something absolutely needs words to be communicated, seemingly as a sort of protection against the more keen of hearing predators that once chased them through the forests. As such, being able to express as much as possible without saying a single word is highly appreciated amongst Maskay societies.

races.name: Bambai-Nekeg
races.description:
The Bambai-Nekeg are a large, insectoid people. Their build is somewhere between a rhino beetle and a praying mantis, with massive outer carapaces and a set of arms suited for quickly grabbing prey (they have two sets of arms: one for hunting, one for grabbing and fine motor work). While they naturally eat meat, their digestive systems aren’t built to handle it unassisted. To supplement their digestion, Bambai-Nekeg eat stones to help break down their food. Over time, the metal in the stones they consume collects in their shell, making them into walking fortresses as they grow older. This does make it difficult for them to run quickly, and degrades their ability to fly as they age. 

Bambai-Nekeg have three reproductive sexes, all of which are required to create children: one creates the eggs, one inseminates them, and one incubates. This means that romantic relationships tend to form in triads - usually the same triads that hunt together.

races.name: Eidola
races.description: A strange collection of sand and magic, the Eidola came from seemingly no ancestors. If you were to believe them, their God blessed them with life. These faceless people are made of stone, and identify and speak through holes they drill into themselves, and percussive instruments. These people have no gender, for they have no need for it, they simply carve and animate the others out of the sands they live in. Due to there unusual circumstance of birth, they have no adolescent period, being considered mature, albeit naive the second they are carved. They can range anywhere from 3ft to 10ft depending on how large their carver makes them, and can alter both their size and appearance later in life, either by adding mass or carving it away. Unless mass is added later on, older Eidola acquire a smooth appearance, as they are slowly worn away from time. As an Eidola dies, they quickly dissipate into the sand they were created from, leaving behind nothing but piles of sand.

races.name: Skippers
races.description: Titantic flightless avian folk, with distinctive black and white plumage, and streamlined bodies adapted for life between the land and seas. These wild folk average a height of well over eight feet tall, with some reaching upwards of eleven. While it is clear the species once spent a great deal of time in the skies, an ancient tragedy has since grounded them. Well adapted for sliding along ice and snow, they thrive in colder areas far from the equator. While their strict seafood diet restricts their ability to hunt most land-based creatures... it does prevent the use of their incredible teeth.

races.name: Skiithar
races.description: The Skiithar, a race of once-aquatic frog people, now roam the lands in endless exile, cursed to flee from the waters that once gave them life. Towering and pale, their slimy skin glistens faintly in the moonlight, and their enormous yellow eyes seem to drink in every shadow and cast a disapproving gaze. Once thriving in the lush swamps and rivers, their curse drives them to dry lands, where they multiply at an alarming rate, their numbers swelling to overwhelm whatever landscape they occupy. They croak in mournful tones of their lost connection to the water, their existence a bitter reminder of the price of hubris.

races.name: Vampiric Coral Ents
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Qraws
races.description: Large and intimidating, these cold-blooded beings have spent much of their history buried beneath bogs, ambushing their prey. Wild and free, Qraws rarely submit to the will of another creature, and this has a storied history; there has yet to be a Qraw that has submitted to the whims of a non-Qraw. While not a populous race, they seem to pride themselves on how tenacious they are despite this fact. However, despite this, not all Qraws are cruel or even aggressive; many in-fact are fiercely loyal.

races.name: Daemon
races.description: Not much is known of these creatures except they come from another plane. They are very aggressive in nature and do tend to lean towards non communual behavior. They have naturally strong skin, sharp claws and teeth, with sharp horns and small tattered wings. Somehow able to adapt to any environment, these creatures are theorized to live in constant hellfire.

races.name: Tak-sa-lotl
races.description:
The Taksalotl are an amphibious people, a harmonious fusion of the charismatic Taksi and the regenerative, water-bound axolotl. With sleek, glistening skin ranging from pale lavender to deep jade, their bodies are adorned with colorful frilled gills that flare from their necks like noble crests. Their eyes are large and expressive, often glowing faintly underwater, and their limbs are strong yet nimble, equally at home in dense jungle canopies or sunken temple ruins.

Naturally curious and quick-witted, the Taksalotl are master traders, mediators, and storytellers, with voices that ripple like gentle waves. Their society prizes adaptability, and cunning—traits they trace back to both their Taksi ancestors’ mercantile acumen and the axolotl’s magical resilience. They view time as a river: ever-flowing, always shifting, and best navigated by those who learn to swim with the current rather than against it.

races.name: Ursiline
races.description: A race of bulky, furry beast folk that starkly resemble bears. They are renowned for their unrelenting aggression in battle, and are easily aggravated.

races.name: Vampiric Human
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Coral Ents
races.description: Slow moving but hard working coral.

races.name: Urkai
races.description:
When the Lyroa Exodites found the Urkai the meeting could only be tense. Larger than a human these gray colored creatures of mottled pebbled skin and - seemingly - pupilless eyes (later revealed to be a thin transparent membrane), moved with ponderous surety. Yet it was their kindness and welcoming, their sharing of their secret passages and cultivated routes, which convinced the exodites to settle. These Urkai are only superficially humanoid, their insides a complex system of digestion and filtering which allows them to turn even a small supply of cave grown mushrooms into a sustainable source of food.

Their bodies are strange things, bulky, made for keeping warm and surviving the sharp winds of high altitudes, covered in leathery growths that mimic the stone around them. Their speech is likewise limited to whispers and the sharp cracks, clicks, and scratches they can make maneuvering their internal gizzard (used for grinding up the hardy nutrient poor plants of the mountains).

races.name: Fulkuun
races.description: A race of echinoderms whose flesh most closely resembles bark. They have the unique ability to give off mind affecting pheromones, which allows the strange-looking entities to get along with most races. Ironically, these people seem to have evolved from a much more violent, and predatory creature. Due to this recent evolution, they are not the brightest of creatures.

races.name: Stouten
races.description: A race of small, but sturdy people that tend to live around heated vents. Their rigid skin makes them nearly impervious to simple weaponry, but at the cost of making them an incredibly undexterous people.

races.name: Vampiric Thumpkins
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Leyborne
races.description:
An artificial race, impossible to create naturally.  They live off the energy of the Leylines, and cannot survive without it, but while they stay within its power, they do not age.  They were originally created from the Ignikin of Sishayo as a method of avoiding the race's naturally short lifespan.

Each Leyborne chooses their own form, and the only constant is that they all have a spherical core of energy surrounded by runes.  Besides that feature, they interact with reality entirely through spells to create magical appendages and otherwise manipulate the world around them.  Each Leyborne therefore looks quite different, although their color generally reveals their origin, with the most common types being red, firey Ignikin made Leyborne, white shining Lumiran made Leyborne, and black or dark purple Palorthin made Layborne

races.name: Orcinicus
races.description: Orca folk that require a great deal of calories to maintain their bright black and white contrast.

races.name: Homo-bobbinus
races.description: Homo-bobbinus are humans, at least they were. Centuries of exuberance has given them a permanently ruddied face and a denser, curved bone structure. They are typically shorter and broader in stature with a hidden strength that comes out when angered, which to be fair, is often. But they also are easily appeased. Though they come in all colors one would expect for humans, they tend towards lighter skin tone and shorter, brown hair.

races.name: Human
races.description: A classic mainstay in any world. Hard working and down to earth. Sadly, when it comes to fantasy races, humans are relatively non-magical.

races.name: Kol'zani
races.description: A small warm blooded reptile that swims the water way of their home island. Being roughly 3'4 and generally about 80ibs with bright blue scales and a knack for fish. These Kol'zani will almost eat any meat, rotting or not even their own kins not safe though they tend to keep together as family even against the wilds. These Kol'zani are good swimmers but are lacking in any magical power.

races.name: Axolotl
races.description: The Axolotl are a race of 2'7  partially transparent water creatures. Its delicate body is lightly tinged with a soft purple hue that seems to glow from within, especially under soft lighting. You can see faint outlines of its internal organs, veins, and bones, which shimmer gently beneath the surface. The light purple tint blends smoothly across its entire body, accentuating the curves of its head, gills, and limbs. The feathery, fringed gills on each side of its head retain their usual pinkish-red color but are softened by the overall purple wash, making it appear otherworldly and fragile, like a creature from a dream or a fantasy realm. These semi-aquatic salamander creatures are never far from the water. Smaller and weaker that most others, they utilize their water adeptness to survive and even thrive. Water is a intrinsic cornerstone of their lifes, both in terms of survival, but as well as cultural and spiritual life

races.name: Shokusha
races.description:
The origins of the Shokusha are quite vague, they are a rather new race with many of the first generation having survived. Even talking to these elders has shown little light on their origin, for the most part the elders have described living around some massive metal structures deep in the ocean before some sort of catalyst seemed to grant their people sentience. Since then small herds have been roaming the world searching for a new home and finally it looks like they might have one in this strange world.

They look rather similar to regular squids having tentacles and the like with a few exceptions, they are substantially larger then the smaller squids that are in the ocean with some growing to be larger then people. They also have developed a number of abilities useful in this new area, they are able to survive outside water even if they much prefer the depths of the ocean and to communicate they have a magical ability to communicate with creatures near them as if they were in their head.

races.name: Trygar
races.description: The Trygar are a a race of thick, brutish fish people. Covered in tough, mottled scales and standing taller than most humans, these hulking creatures possess immense strength and primitive, predatory instincts. With no knowledge of the modern world, they navigate their surroundings with confusion and hostility, driven by their ancient memories of life beneath the waves.

races.name: Carcuka
races.description:
Carnivorous Cannibalistic Crustaceans; Carcuka

 A monstrous race of loosely humanoid four-legged crustaceans that inhabit the sandy shorelines of tropical latitudes, known for their insatiable gluttony and semi-aquatic nature. They boast many features known from common crustaceans, though are taxonomically distant from any other living species. Bearing some similarities to lobsters, deep sea crabs, shrimp, and a number of others. Strict carnivores, the Carcuka are predators through and through, with the physiology to match. They are built heavily, carrying thick chitin on dense frames. Carcuka reach adulthood standing anywhere from 6 to 7 feet, continuing to grow even larger throughout their long lives. The largest known Carcuka stood above 11 feet, but few in recent history have neared that number. They have distinctive ruddy orange or sand hued carapaces, asymmetrical claws boasting one very large weaponized claw and a smaller pinching claw for more dexterous work. Their heads are adorned with two pairs of symmetrical resonance chambers that look somewhat like upturned horns, which function as amplifiers for vocalization and displays for attracting mates. Usually weighing around 500lbs at the end of adolescence, and increasing drastically with further growth, they can become quite massive with age.

Their faces crowd with countless mouth-bits that are entirely alien and unreadable to most, but they do possess emotive blue, green, or black eyes with very large irises. They molt once every year, and are usually fully recovered from the exhaustive process after a week. The very oldest Carcuka are an exception to this, as the larger you grow the more difficult molting becomes. Death by exhaustion or starvation during molting is the only complication of age the Carcuka experience.

races.name: Dredré
races.description:
The Dredré are similar to humans - though perhaps with a touch more magical and desert exposure. Dredré are exceptionally lightweight and quick on their feet, allowing them to move easily over almost any terrain. They have longer, pointed ears that they can rotate freely to pinpoint sources of noise while also allowing them to collect water within the air, and a strong sense of smell that helps their tracking endeavors. 

Their most notable feature, however, is their universal comprehension of language. The Dredré can understand all forms of communication from the time of their birth, including that of plants and animals. This gives them a unique perspective on the natural world, and greatly shapes the cultures they build. Because of this connection with the world, Dredré usually find themselves living more closely with creatures than most other peoples.

races.name: Undead Glüsken
races.description: Brains!!!

races.name: Philanthropist
races.description:
The Philanthropist are a peaceful, quasi-birdlike species of tall, lithe humanoids.
They are a Frail pacifistic race who have been blessed with uncanny luck.
They may have birdlike traits/looks but they do not have the ability to fly.
They can twist/rotate(270 degrees) their head like owls.
They can interbreed with humans(this was discovered during one of the Philanthropist's trade expedition to a human settlement and one of them coupled with our people)

races.name: Palorthin
races.description:
The Palorthin, or as they call themselves ( م̷̂̌ا̵̑̂ ̸̍̏گ̶̇̏م̴͐̚ ̸̇̚ش̴͝ده ایم ) are a species not from this world, they are not from this dimension either. They are beings of collective free extra-dimensional essences from a unknown tiered higher dimension. Having no 'third dimensional' bodies that are sufficient to carry their essences, they take on the impure and wholly unknown materials found within this new world as their vessels of 'choice' to survive. The essences can inhabit any solid form they desire but they prefer to take on smoother vessels with extremities that fulfil their function best, most often comprised of Stone, metals or gems. After possession, the material lifts up from the ground where it floats slightly above the ground. The ones that are supposed to talk to Third Realmers often take on material with head shaped nubs or shapes to make them feel more familiar.

For the Palorthin, this world is quite literally; Hell.
Their home dimension has experienced a great shift after coming into contact with this one, greatly upsetting the status quo and rewriting fundamental principles. This has led the Palorthin to seek for answers to what is happening in their home dimension.
While they do not have pronounced sensory organs, their perceived surroundings are chaotic and completely unknown. This hurts them on a constant basis and they crave the soothing calm of their home dimension. It requires willpower and concentration to remain composed, a overload of differing 'signals' would drive them berserk.
While there may be uncountable م̷̂̌ا̵̑̂ ̸̍̏گ̶̇̏م̴͐̚ ̸̇̚ش̴͝ده ایم in their home dimension, their numbers on this side are very limited, a great deal of effort has to be expended to bring more over from the other side. The Palorthin do not reproduce according to the standard sense of the word rather to expand their presence they bring over their kin.

races.name: Whisperfolk
races.description: Whisperfolk are a strange ethereal people that tend to dwell in quiet, isolated areas. Their pale forms are interconnected in a way rarely understood by outsiders; the destruction of one may sometimes cause a chain reaction, leading to the death of hundreds. Due to this, the Whisperfolk seem to have adapted a form of natural docility. Being that, they rarely come to anger, and are even rarer to come to war. Are they naturally formed spirits, or some sort of magical avatar? This is unknown to even themselves, but they don't mind such a mystery at all.

races.name: Vampiric Tak-sa-lotl
races.description:
See main page

They like blood

races.name: Satyr
races.description: Its a goat, what else did you expect

races.name: Dawi
races.description: Short and Stout people, possessed of a hardy and muscle bound appearance even since the moment brought into their world of Rock and Stone. Measuring hardly ever over the height of five feet, four inches leaves but more than making up in their broad and dense physical make up, leading to many of the Dawi to  Paler than the average mammal they tend to tan rather easily when exposed to sunlight. Dawi hair tends to be exclusively shades of darker colors such as brown or black, however all dawi do carry a fair red haired Dawi in thier line.

races.name: Mohad
races.description: This is a race of ant like humanoids who are bipedal, however they differ from ants due to them reproducing via normal sexual means however still hold their queen as the central figure of their society. They are a social race that focuses primarily on interactions within their own race, and with other insectoids, with them rarely having meaningful interactions with more mammalians species. Their natural evolution has made them prefer to live in tunnel like systems to avoid the natural predators they've encountered, their evolution as also given them a tough chitin, due to the high energy required to maintain and create large amounts of chitin, alongside their tunneling nature they evolved to be shorter in stature sitting at around 5ft 4in.  The Mohad however lack strong magical capabilities due to many of them being basic worker, and soldiers drones in service to the colony, instead focusing on meeting the basic needs of their people instead of trying to master the arcane arts.

races.name: Henko
races.description:
The Henko are formed by powerful mages who have bound the soul of a creature to gems which act as the creatures heart. Once formed it takes the Henko some time before it forms itself a body, these often look like the creatures which it can see leading to most Henko being humanoid, though occasionally it will choose to appear similar to a beast. 

Well they have short lives Henko often keep the memories of there ancestors. This leads to some of the modern Henko holding dozens of different persons memories. 

Once a Henko has chosen a form it is able to make itself a more physical form so that it can wield tools. The physical form is sometimes indecirphable from the regular race but weaker Henko often cannot solidify and look transparent. If the gem is broken then the Henko perishes and all the memories it possesed are lost, Because of this the gem is kept in the middle of it's body where it can keep it from damage.

races.name: Oilskins
races.description: An anthropomorphic boar-people who struggle to communicate due to a lack of vocal tools.

races.name: Saltwalkers
races.description: The Saltwalkers are a strange and haunting people, their tall, wiry frames built for endless treks across the shimmering salt dunes of their homeland. Their long limbs move with an odd grace, each step barely sinking into the ground. Black, hollow eyes stare unblinking, drinking in the blinding glare of the star without flinch or squint. With mouths little more than thin slits, their voices carry as low, screeching tones that echo across the sky like distant, broken winds. Perfectly adapted to their barren world, and little more than remnants of what they once were.

races.name: Athian
races.description: Bipedal fish-like creatures with smooth scales on their stomach for sliding in the snowy climate. A large mouth that seems to split their head in half. They are average around 4-5 feet tall. A subset of an old race of advanced fish people who lived in a very cold climate. Some section of this race left out of the giant lake they lived in before it completely froze over, leaving the old Athians behind. The Athians that survived were forced to live on the land, so their bodies adapted. They are primarily ambush predators, burying themselves deep in the snow.

races.name: Taksi
races.description: A race of catfish-like people, from the humid jungles and wetlands. They live in large communities, with close-knit connections and large households. They spawn vast numbers of eggs at a time, but only every 5 or 6 years, with a creche numbering in the hundreds of spawnlings all looked after together communally. There appears to be sub-species within the Taksi, causing a range of different colourations and fin shapes and sizes, with a select few achieving a long lifespan, becoming venerated elders. They are adept swimmers with a powerful tail and  they retain their ancestral gills. The whiskers are highly sensitive, and during certain times of the year, the tips of the whiskers will glow with bioluminescence. They stand at 5-6ft (150-180cm) tall, though when lying down or swimming with a fully extended tail, can reach 8-9ft (240-270cm) long.

races.name: Aubivante
races.description:
Myterious creatures of innate magical power. They take shape in the form of colorful and vibrant jellyfish, capable of treading the skies and shine as stars in the night. And wherever they tread follow a swirling river of green and red lights. Their azure skin is transparent and soft to the touch, their tentacles slow like silk in the wind and feel as them too. In their bell [head] can be seen if only vaguely a glass-like diamond that is vital to their survival, serving a purpose in a similar capacity to both a heart and a brain.

Compared to their regular water-bound brethren the Aubivantes are relatively long lived, with ages capable of matching those of regular humans. They reproduce differently too, with them requiring to build a fleshy plant-like structure similar in function to an incubator in order to produce more of their kin. A difficult task requiring a great amount of energy to produce a mucus that makes up these plants. These living plants are the home to unborn and baby Aubivantes yet unprepared for the world. These incubators can be as tall as the greatest oaks when they are fully filled with their young and could even form vast forests when many are huddled together. It is for this reason they choose to settle in plains areas where these "Living Forests" may flourish.

Contrary to their delicate appearance these Jellyfish are daring and fearless. They are naturally equipped to deal with most threats that they could possibly encounter, and if that were not enough, they bear a fierce intellect. Aubivantes often go scavenging alone for this reason, confident in their capability and in the ruse of their appearance. They're omnivorous creatures, however they much prefer the taste of meat than they do of greens. But when no prey is to be found they wouldn't complain about eating berries and apples.

cultures.name: Elishian
cultures.description:
What began as a group of Lumiran and Athian refugees fleeing the endless wars of the southern mountains soon grew into something greater. Elisho, once a battle mage who used warfare as a means to pursue peace, came to a painful realization: true peace could never grow in soil soaked with the blood of generational hate.

Turning away from bloodshed, he devoted himself to a new path. Using his magic, Elisho opened portal after portal, guiding many people far from the conflict to a new land — a place where they could begin again.

The settlement he founded stood on a simple yet powerful belief: that conversation must come before steel, and cooperation must be sought by any means before conflict.

cultures.name: Vorkatr-Dawi
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: A-113C Software
cultures.description: Ancient software dictating the creation metrics for new A-113C Droids. To outsiders, this likely represents a rigid albeit archaic dogma.

cultures.name: Squibish
cultures.description: Squibish developed among a conflict avoidant people, whose swiftness in the plains of the Golden Expanse and Igneous Badlands meant that running was always an option. Such wandering has brought them into contact with many cultures, which has likewise cultivated a sense of curiosity, which expresses itself in the desire to learn and integrate new songs into the Squibish's rich musical expressions. Along with this, their curse of eternal youth has granted their culture a vibrant whimsy, which sees them often playing harmless pranks and inventing new games.

cultures.name: Bhug-Dawi
cultures.description: The Bhug-Dawi came to be during a period of rule in Vokatir-Karak that saw many craftsmen dissatisfied, the most individualistic of which eventually left to found Bhug-Karak, leading to a culture more focused on both self-expression and the ability of crafter.

cultures.name: Dyeakian
cultures.description: A Cynical evolution of Lyroan culture, shaped not only by the doubt of the empire to survive the coming tide of the Qad'ashin Horde, but also the long years of travel south in search of a place to found their own nation. One which they found in a place that would be inhospitable if not for a native race willing to welcome them with open arms. Hidden away in their mountains, made to work together.

cultures.name: Velgari
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Pelopain
cultures.description:
The main drive behind this culture is the belief that freedom survives only through shared responsibility. Theis society values merit above birth and duty above privilege. Every citizen stands equal before the law and is expected to contribute to the defence and prosperity of the community. Military service is regarded as a fundamental obligation, fostering a population that is disciplined, self-reliant, and prepared to face hardship together. Respect and value is earned through proven character, wisdom, and sacrifice rather than inherited through bloodline or wealth.

The culture emphasizes resilience, personal accountability, and the quiet dignity of carrying one's own burdens. Citizens are taught to rely on their own abilities while respecting the strength of others, believing that a society is strongest when every individual is capable of standing on equal footing. Honor is found not in conquest alone, but in fulfilling one's duty with discipline, courage, and integrity.

cultures.name: Hwai
cultures.description:
The Hwai are predators, but unlike what many would think a predator acts like, the Hwai are calm, collected and rational. They do not act upon their innate desire to devour and consume. They talk, engage in diplomacy and subterfuge, they do not wish to go to war, neither shed more blood than necessary. The Hwai recognize that their best strength is not their steel but ink. 

A Hwai is also devoted to the Choir and as such for the greater good of the Hwaitees, his every action has the objective of advancing Hwai society further and leading them to prosperity. They don’t put themselves first because they know that accomplishing the desires of the society is accomplishing their own desires.

cultures.name: Forevantine
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Atomos
cultures.description: Children of the original Atomos council, prizing a strong but still small collection of wise men in decision-making. Centuries of isolation molded them into a peace-bringing people rather than one afraid of outsiders.

cultures.name: Yuánrén
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Samsinara
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Zhengyi de Ren
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Tsetlanii
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Luminean
cultures.description: None

cultures.name: Bologo
cultures.description: The Bogolo culture is one which reflects heavily it's people; formed in the quiet winding forest paths, the target of many a nations ambitions, and a life made fleeting by the curse of madness that afflicts their people in their old age. It is a somber thing, made hardy by its unlikely and persistent survival.

cultures.name: Kiwurian
cultures.description:
Life is long, and days are short! The Kiwurian culture is all about making the most of the latter without worrying too much about the former. A classic Kiwurian saying is: We've got all day." 

Gotta get some beurocracy done? Ah, we've got all day. Left side of your domicile tunnel collapsed? No worries, we've got __all__ day. A giant hedgehog ate the princess? *We have got all day.*
