wonders.name: Ethereal City
wonders.effect_description:
Effects & Mechanics:
This Wonder counts as a Cathedral Imperial District with it's synergy if placed on a node, rendering it similarly disabled.

Leadership & Doctrine:
Upon Flowvior’s death, eligible Circulator nations vote to elect a new Flowvior. The nation who was the last Flowvior gets one less vote on the next election for every term they were in office. Publicly known immortals & non-living creatures cannot be the Flowvior.

Ethereal Flow Doctrine outlines religious law; violating it may result in excommunication.
Nations that are majority Flow, unexcommunicated, and invested via MRP (DC 20) may propose Doctrine changes; approved by majority Circulator vote.

Circulators:
Each nation with the same religion as the wonder owner gets 1 Circulator; may be granted more once per session by the Flowvior up to a max of half their current pops rounded down; nations do not have to accept additional Circulators. The Flovier cannot grant themselves a Circulator.
Each Circulator costs $5 (Per Era) per session after the first.
Minimum tithe: $10 (Per Era) per session per Circulator nation.

Tithe Account:
Only the Flowvior Controller can use these funds.
Can be stolen via war occupation or legendary quest.
Nations of the same faith as the wonder owner may donate money to the wonder for a bonus. $75 (Per Era) for a +1 to a MRP or $100 (Per Era) for +1 Temp Karma; capped at $300 (Per Era) per session.
Spending uses: Give loans/investments. / Excommunication ($250 per era). / Edicts ($500 per era, 1/session, affects all nations of the same religion as the wonder owner).

Excommunication:
1 excommunicated nation and character at a time, must have violated the Doctrine. 
Triggers -8 to diplo MRP to nations of the same religion, Cannot benefit from Ethereal Edicts, +33% chance to lose a level of relations with each nation of the same faith as wonder, same nations can declare war on the excommunicated nation with a -50% infamy reduction.
May be lifted by Flowvior, on excommunicated ruler's death, or $300 (per era) indulgence into the tithe account without receiving benefits. 
The same nation cannot be excommunicated twice for the same reason during an age.
Ethereal Edicts:

Conclave Banners: +1Atk/+1Def, +1 Morale, +2 HP; suffer the inverse if war goals are against nations the same religion as wonder owner; +100% upkeep unit upkeep (including laws, if unit has no resource upkeep, double law upkeep instead). 
Flowvior Visit: +20% stab gain chance, -20% stab loss chance, +1 food consumption for every 3 pops.
Proclaim Holy War: +5 points for war goals on nations not of the same faith as wonder owner, +10 if alien faith: +25 Infamy for non-holy wars.
Send Flowvior Rep: +6 to diplo MRPs with Flow nations; -8 with others.
Sanction Monopoly: +4 trade distance and +1 import/export per era; -1 temp karma per two trade slots used for nations not of the same religion as wonder owner.
Archive Access: +1 Researcher production, +4 on Tech reduction; double research job upkeep.
Religious Missions: +6 to religious conversion MRPs, -10% backlash chance; +15% chance a random pop changes to another faith in the region for each conversion
Investigate Heresy: -8 to religiously converting pops in nations of the same religion as the wonder owner, +5 Infamy on conversion attempts of nations of the same religion as the wonder owner; -8 to religious conversion mrps. -4 to diplomacy MRPs.

The destroyer of this wonder suffers double infamy for doing so.

The owner of this wonder pays $100 per session to upkeep it.

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1I-CqSj3M1305sSrLobFpFiDp-oyzx8k2WgKbFE-7Ulc/edit?usp=sharing

wonders.name: Shù Dǐng Jiǎoluò
wonders.effect_description:
+1 pop capacity

Base, non pop altered admin is doubled

Administrator job upkeep doubled

If this wonder is sacked, the owner makes an immediate DC 20 Cunning check or else the bonus effect below is lost:

The owner of the Shù Dǐng Jiǎoluò may ask the Shui Senlin Hive Advisor for advice each session, telling them of a type of mechanical action they want to take: Ex. I want to try and increase relations this session, I want to increase my stability this session, I want to expand this session, etc.

The Hive Advisor will then provide a -10 to the dc of a specified mrp action in the theme of that desired mechanical action, such as: you gain -10 to the dc of increasing relations with the daksha, you gain a -10 to the dc of expanding specifically to this tile, etc. 

Alongside this, the Hive Advisor will always provide the rulers of Jinying, as long as they are from the Nei Lu line, +1 rulership, +1 cunning, and +1 strategy beholden to cap.

If the owner of the Shù Dǐng Jiǎoluò is not a character directly descended from the Nei Lu dynasty bloodline, the advisor will refuse to cooperate with them and may even scheme to supplant them with someone of the bloodline, increasing stability loss chance by 50% and guaranteeing stability loss on ruler death.

wonders.name: Xuros Obelisk
wonders.effect_description:
At the start of each session, the owner of the Xuros Obelisk may choose to store nation magic points within the obelisk, spending them at will to perform any of the following actions.

Recover (5): Friendly nation spell is rerolled, new result must be taken. May only be used once per spell.

Repulse (5): Hostile spell is forced to reroll, new result must be taken. May only be used once per spell.

Repel (5): A chosen non-ruler unit within or adjacent to the borders of this nation is teleported 2d6 hexes in the opposite direction of the wonder. This cannot teleport them into hostile terrain.

Shield (5): Target unit gains a +5 Defense bonus on their next roll this war session, exceeding cap.

Empower (5): Target unit gains a +5 Attack bonus on their next roll this war session, exceeding cap.

Destroy (5): Target non-ruler unit has a 50% chance of being destroyed, and a 50% chance to be reduced to half their HP maximum, rounded up. This may be used once per war session, and must be used at the start of the war session.

Embolden (5): Target unit gains +1 Speed, Armor, HP, Damage, Retaliation Damage, and Morale; and gains the Magical special trait. Increase this cost to 10 when cast on Ruler units. This does not stack, and has a 50% chance to go away at the end of each war session.

Obliterate (10): Prior to a war session's start, select 2d6 hexes. These hexes cannot be entered by any units during the war session. This cannot be used to completely surround any district, wonder or city, cannot be placed in another nation's territory, and cannot be placed on a district, wonder, or city.

Vision (10): Instantly gain 2d10 temporary karma. 

Unite (10): Target nation gains one level of stability, reduces their stability loss chance by 100%, and increases their stability gain chance by 100% for one session. Increase the cost of this action by 5 each time it is used on a nation during an age. 

Reform (10): Target nation may ignore five levels of lost stability resulting from changing non-government laws immediately. Increase the cost of this action by 5 each time it is used on a unique nation during an age.

Manifest (15): Target nation gains +1 Rolling Karma. Increase the cost of this action by 15 each time it is used on a unique nation during an age.

Sanctify (20): Target artifact becomes attached to this wonder, cannot be lost or stolen, and does not count towards the artifact slots of the owner. Only one artifact may be attached to this wonder at a time. This artifact is automatically equipped, not taking up a slot but costing 2 NMP (Per Era) to maintain without a slot.

The Xuros Obelisk currently generates (10) MP a session, placed into storage.

Current Storage: (74/100)

Magic points can never be withdrawn from the Obelisk.


Wish Effect: This wonder can sacrifice 2 of any resource that isn't Magic Points to increase the amount of Magic Points in the wonder by 1.

Ancestral Bonus: The owner of this wonder gains +1 Trade Speed for every ten magic points in storage within this wonder.

wonders.name: The Vorkatir Peaks
wonders.effect_description:
The Vorkatir Peaks

All tiles that are not Mountains or Hills are considered x2 Territory and give the owner of the Wonder a stacking -2.5% chance to gain stability per session.
Hills now produce Food instead of Stone.
The Holder of this Wonder gains access to the Job: Stonespeaker, Which produces 2 admin at the upkeep of 5 stone.
Naturally Occurring nodes within the owner's territory will be kept over era transitions.
The owner of the wonder produces 1 Stone per 2 mountain hexes instead of 3 mountain hexes, in addition for every 5 Mountain Hexes 1 Magic Point is produced, for every 10 mountain hexes 1 unique resource is produced.
Increase the time it takes to terraform anything via the spell or mech-rp by two sessions.

wonders.name: The Vanguard
wonders.effect_description:
The owner of this wonder has a their base movement reduced to 4, spending food or wood increase movement at a ratio of 2:1. It adds additional city cap of 1, more can be added after completing a progress Quest of 20+5 (per city) as well as a very hard completion quest with a max of 3 for total of 4. This wonder also Reduces territory to a maximum of 7 hexes with no way to increase it until the owner settles. +1 RP

Settling Requires the Wonder to be reworked.

wonders.name: Radhanseatic Trade League
wonders.effect_description:
- The owner increases their effective pop capacity by one for every Allied nation within their market that has direct route access to their capital (meaning connected via a route without going through another nation's city or capital) up to a maximum of 2 (Per Era). For AI nations they must be at Allied relations to count. For player nations they must have a public agreement to being counted as "allied" which must be reaffirmed each age. 

- The owner of this wonder can ignore the normal, explicit-permission requirement on route-construction in another nation's territory if that nation is at allied relations with the owner.

- This wonder has an upkeep of 1 Wood (Per Era), increasing by 1 Wood per pop capacity created.

- The owner of the wonder may count this wonder, and all market districts as cities for the purposes of trade.

- The owner may hire mercenaries from the region in which this wonder is located, as if they were within that region.

- Once per age, and by dedicating a mech-rp (DC 5), the wonder may be moved to another hex within the nation by spending one of each non-research resource. This may not be done while at war, or while the wonder is sacked.

***Stats as of S.76 for Number of Allies in Market with Route Connection***
7: U. Duchies, Tarngaka, Shinra, Arkadia, Salema Compact, Lumithal Aislid Alliance, Rye Spirits

wonders.name: The Chromeria
wonders.effect_description:
Upon request by anyone, and acceptance by the owner, a country within diplo distance of the owner can opt into this wonder, gaining some of the advantages and disadvantages.

All members besides the owner of the wonder decrease their Research Point production by one. The DC for AI nations to be invited is DC 25, 20 if they are Welcoming, 15 if they are Curious.

The tech discount for members is equal to 1 + 1 for every 5 members. (This wonder does not bypass the 50% discount cap)

Every session, there is a chance that scientific law increases for every member in the research group (rolled once, applied to all). The chance is 5% per member (Currently 40%). If it succeeds the chance is rolled again, repeating as many times as it occurs. If someone is at the highest level of science stances and were to gain a tier, they instead lose a level of stability (this cannot result in a civil war directly). Each time this chance occurs, each AI nation within the wonder has a 25% chance to leave; once they have left, they cannot be reinvited that or the next session.

The group capacity is 2 per era. (Currently 8)

The owner can "research ahead" one tier under specific conditions, at a steeply inflated price. If a technology on the tree is to be completed in a given turn, and there are excess tech points, said excess points can be invested in the technology immediately after it in the tree, at a rate of 3 tech points for 1 in this "ahead" technology. If you research ahead, you cannot research any techs after that until it is connected to the start of tree. Additionally, the tech that is researched ahead cannot benefit from groundbreaker, along with the next two techs in the tech line.

Current Members:
- Lusariyya
- Velgorod
- New Remnants
- Lokhim Remnant
- Vysaffia Coven
- Bayan Reborne
- 
-

wonders.name: Pathfinder's Lodge
wonders.effect_description:
The owner of the Pathfinder's Lodge gains an Adventurer Faction of the same name. This faction will never act against its owner, may never Incite Rebellion / Seize Control, and will always return after one session if destroyed. Additionally, both of their unique faction actions that the nation can use are boosted, as per below:

Create Quest: The Faction will always dedicate as many mech-rps as possible to the quest, along with purchasing additional mech-rps if necessary. They will never refuse a quest, unless that quest will actively harm them, or the nation.

Summon Hero: The hero summoned from this faction will have their bonus changed from "Very Powerful" to "Tremendously Powerful". Additionally, by spending $500 (Per Era), the hero can be given Slow Aging, this must be spent before the bonus is created.

The above characters may never have slow aging or stop aging cast on them (excluding the slow aging gained by spending money), and can never have their lifespan increased in any way.

Ancestral Bonus: Each time the owner of this wonder were to gain an increase to their lifespan, a random attribute increases by two.

wonders.name: Altar of Ascension
wonders.effect_description:
- Creates a new race called Leyborne with two custom traits, Arcane as the positive trait, and Ethereal as the negative trait.  This race cannot be created by any method other than this wonder
- Willing pops and characters with a race that is a construct or mana being can be racially converted one at a time to Leyborne by performing a DC 10 mech RP and paying 10 nation magic
- When the majority of pops in a nation become Leyborne, the nation ruler has the choice to make the primary race of the nation Leyborne, and they cannot convert before that time

New Positive Trait (Arcane):
- Reduce the casting cost of character spells by 1, and reduce the casting cost of nation magic spells by 1 per 10 pops of this race in the nation, with a minimum discount of 1, and a minimum cost of 2
- War casting no longer gives a stacking penalty to future war casting

New Negative Trait (Ethereal):
- Can only have magical units
- Units must be on or next to magic nodes at all times or they are destroyed
- Nation can only control territory on or next to magic nodes
- Characters of this race cannot go farther than 1 tile from a magic node at any time
- Characters of this race cannot die of old age
- Characters of this race cannot be healed without the use of a spell or artifact
- Characters of this race take an additional health state whenever they are injured
- All food consumption is replaced with magic consumption at a rate of 2 food to 1 magic

wonders.name: Arctic Union
wonders.effect_description:
All nations associated with wonder lose all Defensive & Military pacts; current nations the controller had pacts with may join the wonder.
Union size = 2 per Era

A non-vassal nation is considered an independent for the purpose of this wonder.

Independents may join or be kicked with majority vote from current members; Independents may withdraw whenever; Independents in wonder are considered to have military pacts with other Independents for the sake of outside mechanics; controller’s and independent's vassals join automatically as dependents.

Independents can propose offensive war and must have majority vote for it to be declared; nations that vote no must join.

A nation may propose to ban a law for all nations in the union and if the owner of veto's it, they suffer +15 infamy. Nations within the wonder union suffer 25% stability loss chance for every banned law they have; AI members will prefer to change laws rather than suffer the stability loss chance. At the end of an era, an automatic revote on all banned laws will occur.

A nation may propose to enforce a law change for all nations in the union and if the owner of veto's it, they suffer +15 infamy. If the law is enforced, all nations must change to the law (or one tier towards it on scaled laws) without stab loss.

All votes take place publicly, unless a secret-rp is spent to make them private.

Controller gains +1 Title slot.

Currently Banned Laws:

Exploit Trade Safety Stance

wonders.name: Great Library of Tychi
wonders.effect_description:
The owner of this wonder gains the Curious and Magical positive racial traits, as well as the Craven negative racial trait.

The owner of this wonder must pay 1 wood upkeep, plus 1 additional wood upkeep for every 4 pops they have.

Ancestral Bonus - If a natural 1 is rolled on the benevolence of a pact it may be re-rolled for free.

wonders.name: The Great Archive
wonders.effect_description:
At the start of each session, the owner of the Great Archive may choose to place any tech they have already unlocked into the wonder.

Increase the amount of Research Points this wonder produces and the amount of Wood it consumes by 1 per tech placed into the wonder.

When a tech is placed into the wonder, no benefit is gained from its effects until it is released.

A tech cannot be released once it is placed inside, and is automatically released after 1d4+1 sessions. Once released, a tech cannot be placed back into the wonder.

Additionally, any nation with a defensive pact, military pact or who are the vassals of the wonder owner gain dramatically increased chances of success on all attempts to discount the cost of techs within the wonder.

Lastly, the owner of the wonder gains slightly increased chances of success on all attempts to discount tech costs, or gather research points.

Ancestral Bonus: The owner of this wonder gains a bonus to all conversion checks equal to the amount of Research Nodes they currently possess.

wonders.name: Throne of the Living Current
wonders.effect_description:
Eternal Burden:

The ruler(s) of the controlling nation has an elderly start age of 0, which cannot be increased.  However, they do not suffer the elderly penalty.  All character Magic Production, Storage, Destiny, Title slots and Artifact slots of affected character(s) are transferred to the Wonder itself; only the first character each session generates magic for the wonder. The affected character(s) lose 1 title slot. Their Death Chance is doubled from all sources and cannot be reduced by any means.  The owner may pay 1 Food (Per Era) [increased by 1 (2 if they have a positive magic modifier) each time it is used per age] to ignore Stability loss caused by the death of a ruler and to gain +2 to any one stat. This wonder can be targeted by spells that normally target characters, and the primary ruler of the nation benefits from these spells. Spells cast in this way increase their cost by 25%, rounded up.

Channeling the Current:

- Spells with upkeep may be cast and maintained by the Wonder, drawing on the character’s magic. (this carries over between characters' lives)
- Destinies are rolled every 1d4+2 sessions and must be completed before the next destiny is rolled.
- Artifacts are equipped by the Wonder.
- Titles are held by the Wonder, not the character.

wonders.name: Lokhim Arsenal
wonders.effect_description:
This wonder acts as the highest tier Workshop district available to the nation, which gains the effects of its synergies.

The owner of this wonder may pay $200 (Per Era) and 2 unique resources to increase their *maximum* base military attack and defense by +1/+1. This may be done twice per session, to a maximum of +6/+6 base cap, and +10/+10 upper cap respectively. This goes away after the end of wars the nation is fighting or after two sessions, whichever is later.

Once a session, and while the above bonus is active, if the owner of this wonder loses a non-raid war, their leader suffers a random tier 2 negative title, which automatically goes away the next time they win a non-raid war, or die, whichever is sooner.

Additionally, it increases the amount of units per army they can field by 1.

This wonder counts as a connected hex when the owner of the wonders capital is not on the Island.
This wonder is build under the city of Lun Liwuin and has a upkeep of 1 iron per session.

wonders.name: Spider Daemon Queen's Throne
wonders.effect_description:
The owner of this wonder gains three additional title slots, two for immortals. 

Each session, the owner also gains a choice between two random positive titles. If the owner character is immortal, these choices can never be tier 3's.

wonders.name: The Vine God's Garden
wonders.effect_description:
During a defensive war, all territory of the owner of this wonder counts as Attrition for enemies of the owner, and any attempt to ignore this attrition suffers +5 DC. 

Additionally, if territory already has attrition, it's worth 1/2 instead of 1/4 damage.

mrp_defs.name: Assimilate Culture
mrp_defs.description: Encourage pops of a different culture, at home or in a nearby nation, to adopt the nation's own culture.
Shift the nation's diplomatic posture to better serve its current ambitions.
mrp_defs.name: Diplomatic Overture
Convert Faith
mrp_defs.description: Send missionaries to bring pops of a different religion, at home or in a nearby nation, into the nation's own faith.
Push through a change to the nation's scientific/civic doctrine to address chronic unrest — targets whichever stance best reduces instability.
mrp_defs.name: Constitutional Reform
Character Training
mrp_defs.description: The ruler dedicates time to personal training, sharpening whichever skill this session's efforts favored.
Send scouts to survey and formally claim nearby unclaimed land.
mrp_defs.name: Scout and Claim New Territory
Heir Training
mrp_defs.description: The nation invests in preparing whoever will succeed the current ruler, banking training that manifests in its next leader.
A rousing speech or show of strength meant to bolster the resolve of the nation's forces before battle.
mrp_defs.name: Inspire the Troops

mrp_defs.description: Court merchants, nobles, and guilds for emergency funds.
mrp_defs.name: Fundraising Campaign
